purpose: Complete full-length development checks, select a demonstration, then evaluate five new public recordings with a frozen estimator
selection: First five numerically ordered available dataset directories after subject18; availability listing inspected before downloading recordings or reference measurements; subject19 and subject21 absent from mirror
demo_selection: Development recordings only: >=80% nominal windows have a scorable estimate and accepted-set device-label MAE <=5 BPM; rank by scorable fraction then MAE then recording ID; select continuous policy for presentation
reference: Stored device BPM on analyzed support, existing validity checks, assumed elapsed-time offset zero
failure_policy: Keep unavailable downloads, inference failures and rejected windows explicit; no substitutions or estimator changes after fresh results
public_outputs: Code, acquisition manifests and cohort aggregates only; annotated recording and detailed pulse measurements are delivered privately
